status: AUGMENTED PREREGISTRATION BEFORE NEW DATA OR RESULTS
question: Does replacing total by rest score change operational latent-null Holm-FWER for the same ordinal-LR procedure? No assumption that rest score fixes the latent/observed conditioning mismatch.
methods: production ordinal LR omnibus, total score
same production ordinal LR omnibus, rest score excluding studied item
dgp: Existing gen_ordinal, N500/500 J10 C4 a=linspace(.9,1.8), b=linspace(-1,1)+[-1,0,1], normal theta mean0/-0.5 SD1, no true latent DIF, local independence
matching: Total uses all ten items including target; rest uses the other nine. No purification or selected anchors; exact same raw matrix and row order for both methods.
multiplicity: Holm across the same two items primary; BH descriptive secondary
primary: Mean paired dataset-level Holm event difference D=I_total-I_rest
estimand_note: False-DIF operating risk relative to latent invariance, not the same formal conditional null for the two matching variables
n_derivation: D in [-1,1] implies Var(D)<=1, so true MCSE(mean D)<=1/sqrt(R). R=ceil(1/.02^2)=2500. This is not a .02 confidence-halfwidth target.
primary_ci: Fixed-R marginal two-sided distribution-free Hoeffding: mean D +/- sqrt(2 log(2/.05)/R), clipped to [-1,1]
secondary_fwer_intervals: Per-method exact CP at 97.5% (Bonferroni joint >=95% for two methods). These do not guarantee the older PR118 .02 interval-deviation target.
acceptance: For paired direction, primary interval must exclude0, after full fixed R and prespecified validity checks. Method-specific scoped control requires upper bound<=.05, inflation lower>.05; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. No general method certification or production-label change.
failures: Retain all data/results. Any incomplete item family invalid. Report valid-case paired statistics and missing-pair sensitivity; no failed test imputed as no rejection. Confirmatory precision claim only with complete valid fixed R; otherwise diagnostic/inconclusive.
seed_rule: 2026110100 + replication_index, same raw data for both methods; no outcome-dependent seed replacement
timing_rule: Pilot included in fixed2500 only if all tests valid and no method/settings change. Stop if projected total exceeds1800s. No threshold/precision adjustment after outcomes.
timing_limitation: Rest timing not yet measured; estimate is not guaranteed; 30-pair feasibility stage required. No optional stopping for significant/favorable results. Budget/validity stop => no confirmatory acceptance.
scope_limits: Only this DGP/impact/test length/family/no-selection setting; no power, anchor-selection or general FDR claims
discordance_definition: b=total Holm event only; c=rest Holm event only; a=both; d=neither. Delta=(b-c)/valid complete pairs.
mcnemar: Exact two-sided conditional binomial test b | (b+c) ~ Binomial(b+c,0.5); b+c=0 => p=1 with no-discordance warning; zero valid pairs => undefined. This tests equal marginal event probabilities, not nominal FWER control.
paired_exact_ci: Conservative exact-coverage 95% paired risk-difference interval: pi=P(discordance), q=P(total-only | discordance), Delta=pi*(2q-1). Separate 97.5% CP intervals for pi from m/N and q from b/m give joint coverage >=95% by union bound. Min/max product over corners. m=0 => q interval [0,1], never zero-width certainty.
primary_rule: Original primary Hoeffding interval and fixed-R validity/precision rules retained. Exact paired CI and McNemar are supplementary sensitivity/inference, never selected post hoc to override a primary inconclusive result or certify FWER.
method_ci: Individual method FWER with 97.5% exact CP, joint >=95% for two methods; separate unknown-failure bounds. No equality/nominal control inferred from McNemar.
feasibility_decision: Run exactly first30 pairs, inspect validity and runtime only; do not use event counts or effect direction to select expansion. Continue only if 30/30 pairs valid and elapsed/30*2500 <=1800s. No retries or seed replacement. Main may retain later failed pairs; no confirmatory acceptance unless fixed2500 complete valid pairs.
budget_deadline: 1800s fitting wall deadline; interrupted attempted pair recorded invalid with partial diagnostics. Reset timer after execution. Budget/feasibility stops remain diagnostic, not confirmatory.
data_storage: Compressed first30 response matrices and any failed-pair matrices; every repeat stores seed, data-content hash, raw statistics/p, Holm/BH and event decisions in append-only JSONL then verified deterministic gzip. All full responses reproducible from fixed source/versions/seed; no 2500 duplicate CSV files.
missing_pairs: Never impute failed analysis as no event. Conditional complete-pair estimates, b/c, missing-pair empirical sensitivity, per-method failures and conservative failure envelopes; incomplete experiment => INCONCLUSIVE.
paired_mcse_formula: sqrt((sum(D^2)-sum(D)^2/n)/(n-1)/n), D in {-1,0,1}; n<2 undefined. Report zero empirical MCSE with nonzero interval uncertainty.
stopping_after_main_failure: Retain failures without retry; continue while within budget to estimate failure rate. Confirmatory acceptance remains disabled if any invalid pair.
no_other_engines: Only production ordinal LR for total/rest. No GRM-LR, 4PL, R or new estimator.
